The problem is the geometry: per cluster G (redundancy staging), P6830 and P6831 share ONE drawn trace measuring 83.21 km (76.747,43.291 -> 77.229,43.298), which matches NEITHER line's own stated length (64.40 km for I, 62.40 km for II) -- it is roughly 19-21 km longer than either. That rules out the two commonest length_ratio patterns (whole-system-length-on-a-portion, or a phased/segment row) because there is no larger 'system' here bigger than the two lines themselves, and both lines are already full builds, not phases of a longer corridor. Most likely explanation, unconfirmed: the digitized route includes lead-in/approach segments (e.g. the Almaty-side tie-in through TIP-04, the bridge connector between Almaty-Bayserke-Talgar and the Kazakhstan-China pipeline mentioned in neftegazpro.ru's coverage of line II construction) that extend beyond the two lines' own commissioned mainline lengths. This is a geometry-quality question for a human to weigh, not a value dispute -- I am not proposing new coordinates per protocol.
